description: This file implements a command-line shell interface for controlling LEDs in a Zephyr RTOS environment, including functions to turn LEDs on/off, get info, set brightness, color, and channels.

methods.name: parse_common_args
methods.description: Parses common command-line arguments to retrieve device and LED number.

methods.name: cmd_get_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specified LED.

methods.name: cmd_set_brightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level of a specified LED.

methods.name: cmd_set_color
methods.description: Sets the color(s) of a specified LED.

methods.name: cmd_set_channel
methods.description: Sets a specific channel value for an LED.

methods.name: cmd_write_channels
methods.description: Writes multiple channel values starting from a specified channel.
